blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Understanding information processing in large language models (LLMs) requires dissecting the geometric organization of their internal token representations. While existing mechanistic interpretability (MI) methods seek to extract human-understandable concepts, they are constrained by a strong linearity assumption—an assumption increasingly challenged by evidence of non-linear feature manifolds. In this work, we move beyond linear concepts by adapting Non-Linear Multi-Dimensional Concept Discovery (NLMCD) from computer vision to token-level LLM activations, modeling concepts as low-dimensional manifolds. To enable quantitative comparison of these independently discovered concept manifolds across layers and models, we introduce a concept-based alignment (CBA) score, a generalized Rand index that measures geometric proximity without requiring explicit feature matching. Our analysis yields six key findings: (i) a neighboring-layer sanity check shows CBA is more sensitive than PCA- or CKA-based linear baselines; (ii) layer×layer alignment matrices reveal two characteristic block structures concentrated in intermediate and late layers, consistent across models and obscured by linear metrics; (iii) concept composition remains syntax-dominated through most of the network before giving way to increasingly mixed syntactic–semantic concepts in later layers, with increasing output-orientation toward the final layers; (iv) multilingual concept sharing between English and Mandarin is training-dependent rather than universal — strongest in Qwen, weaker in Llama, and absent in GPT-2; (v) inter-model alignment mirrors this structure: strong correspondence between same-family Qwen models of different scale, consistent with the block structures in (ii), but weak alignment across model families; and (vi) tracing representational alignment across the training stages of the Tulu-3 pipeline shows alignment is highest between adjacent stages, validating CBA, with the largest shift occurring between the base model and the SFT stage, while subsequent preference-alignment stages (DPO, RLVR) leave early layers largely unchanged and RLVR mostly preserves DPO’s concepts in late layers.
blocks.zh: 理解大语言模型(LLMS)中的信息处理需要解析其内部符号表示的几何组织. 虽然现有的机械可解释性(MI)方法试图提取人能理解的概念,但它们受到强烈的线性假设的限制——这种假设越来越多地受到非线性特征多重证据的挑战。 在这部作品中,我们超越了线性概念,将非线性多维概念发现(NLMCD)从计算机视觉改造为符号级LLM激活,模型化的概念作为低维多维. 为了对这些独立发现的概念进行跨层和跨模型的定量比较,我们采用了基于概念的对齐(CBA)分数,这是一个通用的兰德指数,它测量几何近距离,而不需要明确的特征对齐. 我们的分析得出6项关键结论:(一) 相邻层次的智商检查显示,CBA比基于PCA或CKA的线性基线更敏感;(二) 层×层对齐矩阵显示两个特征块结构集中在中层和后层,各模型之间一致,被线性度量表所掩盖;(三) 概念构成通过大多数网络仍然以语法为主,然后再让位于后层的日益混合的合成-语义概念,产出方向日益向最后层倾斜;(四) 英语和普通话之间的多语概念共享是依赖培训而不是通用的——在Quen语中最强,在Llama语中较弱,在GPT-2语中缺失;(五) 模型对齐结构:同一家庭之间的强烈对应。 与(二)中的块状结构一致,但模式家族之间协调不力的Quen模型;和(六)追踪图卢-3管道培训阶段之间的代表式协调,显示相邻阶段之间的协调程度最高,验证CBA,基模型和SFT阶段之间发生最大的转变,而后续的偏好调整阶段(DPO,RLVR)则使早期层基本保持不变,RLVR大多在后层保留DPO的概念.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are gaining traction in a variety of tasks, most notably as assistant chatbots, as agents that solve complex tasks, and as coding support, making them among the most influential machine-learning paradigms of the present day. As LLMs are trained, scaled, finetuned, and adapted across languages, a recurring question is whether and how their internal representations change: Does finetuning reorganize concepts or merely refine them? Do larger models within a family preserve the representational structure of smaller ones? Do multilingual models encode shared, language-agnostic concepts, or largely separate ones per language? Answering such questions requires comparing internal representations across layers, model scales, training stages, and languages — a task that depends entirely on having a reliable notion of representational alignment.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)在各种任务中获得了牵引力,最显著的是作为助理聊天人,作为解决复杂任务的代理,以及作为编码支持,使其成为当今最具影响力的机器学习范式. 由于法学硕士受到不同语文的培训、调整、调整和调整,一个反复出现的问题是其内部表现是否以及如何改变: 重新调整概念还是仅仅修改概念? 家庭内较大的模型是否保留较小模型的代表性结构? 多语种模型是共享的,语言不可知的概念,还是每个语言基本分开的概念? 回答这些问题需要比较不同层次、模型规模、培训阶段和语文的内部代表情况,这项任务完全取决于对代表关系的可靠概念。

blocks.en: The standard tools for this comparison are global alignment metrics such as Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) or canonical correlation analysis (CCA). These methods compare entire activation spaces under an implicit linear representation hypothesis: similarity is measured via linear projections or kernel similarities over the full activation vector, rather than over the discrete, interpretable units (concepts, features) that individual activations may encode. This is a poor fit for evidence that some computationally relevant structures in LLMs are intrinsically multi-dimensional and non-linear ( Engels et al., 2025 ) , and it makes such metrics comparatively insensitive: two representation spaces can appear highly similar under CKA/CCA even when their underlying concept structure diverges substantially at a finer grain.
blocks.zh: 这种比较的标准工具是全球对齐度量,如中枢对齐(CKA)或犬科关联分析(CCA). 这些方法在隐含的线性表示假说下比较整个激活空间:相似度是通过线性预测或内核在完全激活矢量上的相似度来测量的,而不是相对于单个激活可能编码的离散,可解释的单位(概念,特征). 这不足以证明LLMs中一些在计算上相关的结构是内在的多维和非线性(Engels等人,2025年),因此,这种衡量标准相对来说不敏感:在CKA/CCA中,两个代表空间可能看起来非常相似,即使其基本概念结构在细粒子上存在很大差异。

blocks.en: We investigate an alternative based on Non-Linear Multi-Dimensional Concept Discovery (NLMCD) ( Vielhaben et al., 2026 ) , which treats concepts as density-supported manifolds rather than linear directions. It builds on evidence, including from sparse autoencoders (SAEs), that concept-level decompositions of LLM activations are a productive unit of comparison ( Bricken et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2024 ) , while relaxing the linearity assumption most such methods share. Activations are embedded with UMAP, clustered with HDBSCAN, and represented by fuzzy token-to-concept memberships. These memberships enable Concept-Based Alignment (CBA), a fuzzy generalization of the Rand index that compares the pairwise relations induced by two independently discovered concept spaces — without requiring the same architecture, tokenizer, or training stage on both sides, unlike global alignment metrics that presume a shared coordinate system. While the discovered concepts could also support other uses, such as mechanistic interpretability, we focus entirely on their use for alignment, and present a comprehensive view of intra- and inter-model representational alignment across a variety of LLMs.
blocks.zh: 我们调查一种基于非线性多维概念发现(NLMCD)(Vielhaben等人,2026年)的替代方法,它把概念视为密度支持的多元性,而不是线性方向。 它基于证据,包括来自稀疏的自动编码器(SAEs)的证据,即LLM激活的概念级分解是比较的一个生产单位(Bricken等人,2023年;Gao等人,2024年),同时放松了大多数此类方法共享的线性假设. 激活与UMAP嵌入,与HDBSCAN集群,并以模糊的符号对概念成员为代表. 这些成员使基于概念的对齐(CBA)成为可能,这是对兰德指数的模糊概括,它比较了两个独立发现的概念空间所引发的对称关系——不需要在两边设置相同的结构、标致器或培训阶段,与假设共享坐标系统的全球对齐度量不同。 虽然已发现的概念也可支持其他用途,例如机械解释性,但我们完全侧重于将其用于协调统一,并全面审视各种有限责任公司之间模式内和模式间代表式的协调统一。

blocks.en:
Our technical contributions and most important findings are:
(R0) We adapt NLMCD to residual stream hidden activations and validate the resulting clustering via coverage, reconstruction, and density-based quality metrics. (R1) We propose a neighboring-layer sanity check showing CBA is more sensitive than PCA- and CKA-based baselines. (R2) We find qualitatively similar block structures in layer × \times layer alignment across models, with two characteristic blocks in intermediate and late layers. (R3) We characterize discovered concepts quantitatively in terms of syntactic/semantic content, finding a relative decrease of purely syntactic concepts in favor of joint syntactic-semantic concepts toward later layers, alongside increasing output-orientation toward final layers. (R4) We find multilingual concepts shared across an aligned English–Mandarin corpus, strongest in Qwen, weaker in Llama, and absent in GPT-2. (R5) We find strong inter-model alignment between same-family Qwen models of different scale, consistent with the block structures identified in (R2), but weak structural alignment across model families. (R6) We trace representational alignment across Tulu-3 training stages: alignment is highest between adjacent stages, validating CBA; the largest shift occurs between the base model and SFT; and preference-alignment (DPO, RLVR) leaves early layers largely unchanged while RLVR mostly preserves DPO’s concepts in late layers. Fig. 1 summarizes the method and the three main uses studied in this paper.
blocks.zh:
我们的技术贡献和最重要的结论是:
(R0)我们使NLMCD适应残留流的隐藏激活,并通过覆盖、重建和密度质量测量来验证由此产生的集群。 (R1)我们提议进行邻接层的智商检查,显示CBA比基于PCA和CKA的基线更敏感. (R2)我们发现在层×\times层间跨模型的对齐,中间层和后层有两个特征块,质量相似的块结构. (R3)我们从合成/语义内容的角度对发现的概念进行定量定性,发现纯粹的合成概念相对减少,有利于联合合成-语义概念向后层发展,同时增加产出导向最终层。 (R4)我们发现,在一致的英语-曼达林语中,多语种的概念是共享的,在Quen语中最强,在Llama语中较弱,在GPT-2语中缺失。 (R5) 我们发现不同规模的同家族Quen模型之间有很强的模型间一致,与(R2)中确定的块状结构一致,但模型家族之间的结构一致薄弱. (R6)我们追踪图卢-3训练阶段的表示一致:相邻阶段之间的表示一致最高,验证CBA;基模型和SFT之间发生最大的转变;偏好调整(DPO,RLVR)使得早期层基本保持不变,而RLVR则大多保留了DPO在后层的概念. 图1总结了本文中研究的方法和三个主要用途。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of NLMCD-NLP. Layer-wise token activations are clustered into nonlinear concepts with fuzzy memberships. Using a concept-based alignment (CBA) score, we conduct several experiments on these concept manifolds.
blocks.zh: 图1:NLMCD-NLP概览. 层-层符号激活被组合成非线性概念,成员模糊。 利用基于概念的校正(CBA)分数,我们对这些概念的多元性进行了一些实验.

blocks.en: 2 Non-linear concept discovery
blocks.zh: 2 非线性概念发现

blocks.en: For every model and language, we process 5,000 sentences in batches of eight, truncate them to 128 tokens, and retain a shared reservoir of 100,000 token positions using reservoir sampling ( Vitter, 1985 ) . A common sampling stream ensures that row i i denotes the same token position at every layer. We record the residual output of each of the transformer blocks for all layers of the respective model. We look at models with a hidden dimension ranging from 768–5,120 across 12–64 layers. Residual activations are L2 normalized before concept discovery.
blocks.zh: 对每种模式和语言,我们分批处理5000句8句,将其缩短到128个符号,并使用水库取样保留10万个符号位置(Vitter,1985年)。 一个常见的采样流可以确保一行i表示每一层的相同符号位置. 我们记录每个变压器区块的剩余输出,用于各不同型号的所有层. 我们从12-64层的768 - 5,120 个隐藏维度的模型来看。 剩余激活在概念发现前是L2正常化的.

blocks.en: We follow the concept discovery approach of Vielhaben et al. (2026) even including hyperparameter settings. For each layer independently, UMAP maps the activation reservoir to 50 dimensions with 30 neighbors, minimum distance 0.01, and seed 42 ( McInnes et al., 2018 ) . HDBSCAN then discovers density-supported clusters with minimum cluster size and minimum samples both set to 50, leaf cluster selection, and explicit noise assignments ( Campello et al., 2013 ) . We use one fixed profile across layers and checkpoints so that comparative results are not confounded by per-layer hyperparameter optimization. Missing mass represents HDBSCAN noise or uncertainty.

We evaluate nine checkpoints from four families: GPT-2 ( Radford et al., 2019 ) , our MI baseline for comparison with prior SAE/NMF work and our English-only contrast for the multilingual analysis (Result 4); Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , our main cross-architecture reference (Results 2, 3, 5), kept over Llama 4 since the latter is multimodal MoE; and Qwen3-4B/8B/32B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , providing a scale sweep (Result 2) and multilingual coverage (Result 4). Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct form our matched-scale cross-architecture pair (Results 2–4), chosen for their contrasting data provenance and tokenizers. We use dense Qwen3 rather than Qwen3.5/3.6, which are natively multimodal and would confound scale/language effects with training-paradigm differences; Qwen3 remains the most recent text-only checkpoint in this family, a tradeoff we make explicit.
blocks.zh: 我们评估了来自四个家庭的9个检查站:GPT-2(Radford等人,2019年),与以往SAE/NMF工作相比较的MI基线,以及我们仅使用英语进行多语种分析的对比(Result 4);Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct(Grattafiori等人,2024年),我们的主要跨结构建筑参考文献(Results 2,3,5),因为后者是多模式MoE;Qune3-4B/8B/32B。 (Yang等人,2025年),提供规模扫描(成果2)和多语种覆盖(成果4). Qune3-8B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 组成了匹配比例的跨结构对(Results 2–4),以对比数据出处和示意剂而选择. 我们使用密集的Quen3而不是Quen3.5/3.6,这是本土的多种模式,会把规模/语言效应与培训-paradigm差异混为一谈;Quen3仍然是这个家庭中最新的仅文本的检查站,我们明确表明这一取舍。

blocks.en: For the finetuning-drift case study (Result 6), we use the Tulu-3-8B suite (base, SFT, DPO, final) ( Lambert et al., 2025 ) , built on Llama-3.1-8B and, unlike most released models, exposing every intermediate training stage. This lets us separate drift due to supervised finetuning from drift due to preference/RL optimization (DPO, then RLVR), and its shared initialization with our Llama-3.1-8B checkpoint additionally enables a secondary comparison against Meta’s own RLHF-tuned Instruct release. More details on the desiderata for model choice can be found in App. A.1 .
blocks.zh: 对于微调驱动案例研究(Result 6),我们使用基于Llama-3.1-8B的Tulu-3-8B套件(Base, SFT, DPO, final)(Lambert et al., 2025),与大多数发布模型不同,暴露了每一个中级培训阶段. 这让我们可以区分由于偏好/RL优化(DPO,然后是RLVR)而有监督地微调和漂移(DPO,然后是RLVR)而导致的漂移,并且它与我们的Llama-3.1-8B检查站共享初始化,从而能够与Meta自己的RLHF调图指令发布进行二次比较。 关于模型选择的 desiderata 的更多细节见App. A.1.

blocks.en: Concept discovery uses 5,000 sentences per language. English is sampled from WikiText-103; the joint English–Mandarin discovery corpus is described in Result 4. Coverage is the non-noise token fraction, and Density-Based Clustering Validation (DBCV) assesses cluster separation ( Moulavi et al., 2014 ) . Embedding diagnostics include raw NRMSE over 20,000 sampled pairs. For the R1/R2 within-model comparisons, CBA, PCA-512, linear CKA, and RBF CKA use the same deterministic sample of 5,000 token rows across layers. PCA-512 treats positive principal-component scores as soft concepts.
blocks.zh: 概念发现使用每种语言5000句. 英文样本来自WikiText-103;联合英文-曼达林发现器在成果4中描述. 覆盖面是非噪声符号分数,基于密度的集群验证(DBCV)评估集群分离(Mouravi等人,2014年)。 嵌入式诊断包括生的NRMSE超过20,000对样本. 对于模型内的R1/R2比较,CBA,PCA-512,线性CKA,和RBF CKA使用相同的确定性样本,跨层5000个令牌行. PCA-512将正本成分分数视为软概念.

blocks.en: 3 Related work
blocks.zh: 3个 相关工作

blocks.en: Representational alignment measures have been categorized in recent reviews ( Sucholutsky et al., 2025 ; Klabunde et al., 2025 ) . The most widely used alignment measure for neural representations is centered kernel alignment (CKA) ( Kornblith et al., 2019 ) , which is based on the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence criterion ( Gretton et al., 2005 ) . It is invariant to orthogonal transformations and isotropic scaling. Often linear kernels are used in CKA for computational efficiency and similar performance compared to non-linear kernels. In vision, NLMCD ( Vielhaben et al., 2026 ) has been proposed as a way to capture the more finegrained alignment scores that incorporate the finestructure. The score is based on a generalized Rand-index between fuzzy clusterings. This work explores the use of the NLMCD alignment measure in the context of LLMs.
blocks.zh: 最近的审查对代表性调整措施进行了分类(Sucholutsky等人,2025年;Klabunde等人,2025年)。 神经表达法最广泛使用的对齐措施是中心内核对齐(CKA)(Kornblith等人,2019年),它基于希尔伯特-施密特独立标准(Gretton等人,2005年). 它与正交转化和异热带的缩放不相适应。 与非线性内核相比,常在CKA中使用线性内核进行计算效率和类似性能. 在愿景中,NLMCD(Vielhaben等人,2026年)被提议作为捕捉包含精细结构的更精细的对齐分数的方法. 得分基于模糊集群之间的通用Rand-index. 这项工作探索了在LLMs背景下使用NLMCD对齐措施.

blocks.en: A separate line of work addresses cross-space alignment without assuming explicit feature correspondence or a shared coordinate system. Moschella et al. (2023) propose relative representations, enabling zero-shot stitching between independently trained latent spaces. Alvarez-Melis and Jaakkola (2018) instead frame cross-lingual word embedding alignment as an unsupervised Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport problem. Both approaches share our goal of comparing representation spaces without explicit matching, but operate at a coarser granularity: they align whole embedding spaces or point clouds, whereas CBA compares discovered concept manifolds using alignment scores to be attributed to specific, interpretable concepts rather than reported as a single global statistic.
blocks.zh: 单独的一行工作涉及跨空间对齐,而不假定明确的特征对应或共享坐标系统. Moschella等人(2023年)提出了相对的表述,使得独立训练的潜在空间之间能够进行零镜头缝合. Alvarez-Melis和Jaakkola(2018年)将跨语言词嵌入对齐设定为无监督的Gromov-Wasserstein最佳运输问题. 这两种方法都与我们的目标一致,即比较没有明确匹配的表示空间,但运行在一个较短的颗粒性:它们使整个嵌入空间或点云一致,而CBA则利用对齐的分数来比较已发现的概念倍数,将其归结于具体、可解释的概念,而不是作为单一的全球统计报告。

blocks.en: The NLMCD hinges on representational substructures, which are often referred to as concepts. The most commonly considered structures are linear subspaces, in the case of LLMs typically discovered by means of sparse autoencoders with a linear decoder model. This generalized concept definition aligns with recent findings on non-linear substructures in LLM representation spaces ( Levy and Geva, 2024 ; Geiger et al., 2026 ; Wurgaft et al., 2026 ; Wurgaft and others, 2026 ) . Instead of combining SAE directions, this work takes a more direct path and leverages NLMCD’s concept definition as general manifolds.
blocks.zh: NLMCD依赖于代表子结构,这些结构常被称为概念. 最常被考虑的结构是线性亚空间,在LLMS中,典型的是通过线性解码器模型的稀疏自动编码器发现的. 这一通用概念定义与最近关于LLM代表空间中非线性亚结构的结论一致(Levy and Geva, 2024;Geiger等人, 2026;Wurgaft等人, 2026;Wurgaft等人, 2026)。 这项工作不是结合SAE方向,而是走更直接的道路,利用NLMCD的概念定义作为一般的多元性.

blocks.en: Cross-architectural alignment has been investigated in ( Piepereit, 2026 ) revealing that trained models show above-random representational alignment, which is weak in absolute terms and strongly architecture-dependent. It has also been used in ( Potter et al., 2026 ) to assess representational similarity in multi-agent interactions. Shen et al. (2026) investigated latent reasoning using CKA. CKA-based alignment scores have also been used for specific applications, such as REEF ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) and AWM ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) to derive representation-based fingerprints for LLMs. Overall, CKA has been used to assess representational alignment within and across LLMs, but CKA as alignment measure has rarely been contested. Second, there is not a dedicated alignment study that investigates representational similarity intra- and inter-model in a comprehensive fashion. This is the gap that this submission aims to fill.
blocks.zh: 在(Piepereit, 2026年)调查了跨结构的对齐,揭示了训练有素的模型表现出高于随机的代表性的对齐,在绝对值上是弱的,对建筑的依赖性很强. 它还被用于(Potter等人,2026年)评估多剂相互作用中的代表性相似性。 沈等编著. (2026)利用CKA调查潜在推理. 基于CKA的对齐分数也被用于特定应用,如REEF(张等人,2025年)和AWM(曾等人,2026年)为LLMs获取基于表示的指纹. 总体而言,CKA被用于评估有限责任公司内部和相互之间的代表性一致性,但作为一致性措施的CKA很少受到质疑。 第二,没有开展专门的调整研究,全面调查模型内部和模型之间的代表性相似性。 这是本呈件旨在填补的空白。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Concept Quality Across Layers: The quality of the concepts extracted from each model is shown across the network depth. For each model, concepts are extracted and evaluated at every layer. (Left) Coverage: the fraction of non-noise tokens. (Middle) Density-based clustering validation (DBCV), which assesses cluster separation. (Right) Embedding quality (NRMSE): the raw normalized root-mean-square error between pairwise distances in the activation space and the reduced embedding.
blocks.zh: 图2:跨层概念质量: 从每个模型中提取的概念的质量在整个网络深度中显示。 对于每个模型,每个层次都提取和评价概念。 (左)覆盖:非噪声符号的一小部分. (中)基于密度的集群验证(DBCV),用于评估集群分离. (右)嵌入质量(NRMSE):激活空间中双向距离与减少嵌入之间的原始正态根-正方位误差.

blocks.en: Across models, we observe a median coverage, i.e., fraction of non-noise tokens, of 0.4469, substantially higher than the ∼ \sim 0.2 typical of vision foundation models ( Vielhaben et al., 2026 ) , likely reflecting the greater semantic richness of language relative to vision. Coverage declines from ∼ \sim 0.65 in early layers to ∼ \sim 0.4 in later layers across all models, consistent with the increasing difficulty of capturing the richer representational structure of higher-level features; even so, late-layer coverage remains substantial by vision-domain standards. DBCV, a density-based validity index contrasting intra- vs. inter-cluster density, bounded in [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] with higher indicating better-separated clusters, shows a median of 0.2743, somewhat lower than the ∼ \sim 0.5 typical in vision foundation models, and correlates strongly with coverage, again pointing to superior clustering quality in earlier layers. Reconstruction quality (NRMSE, see App. A.2 ) follows the same trend, falling from 10-12 in early layers to 3-4 in later layers, converging to values comparable to those reported in the vision setting. Taken together, these results support the technical validity of the concept discovery step itself. We highlight the robustness of the NLMCD approach which transfers from vision to LLMs without the necessity to adapt hyperparameter settings.
blocks.zh: 在整个模型中,我们观察到一个中位覆盖率,即非噪声信号的一小部分,为0.4469,大大高于视觉基础模型(Vielhaben等人,2026年)的典型的\sim 0.2,可能反映出语言相对于视觉的语义丰富。 覆盖率从早期的 \sim 0.65 下降到所有模型的后期的 \sim 0.4 ,这与越来越难以捕捉更高层次特征的更丰富的代表性结构相一致;即使如此,根据视野领域标准,晚期覆盖率仍然很高。 DBCV是一种密度有效性指数,与集群内部密度和集群间密度形成对比,以[− 1, 1] [-1, 1]为界,其显示的分类较好的集群较高,其中位数为0.2743,略低于视野基础模型中典型的\\sim 0.5,并与覆盖范围密切相关,再次表明早期的集群质量较高。 重建质量(NRMSE,见App.A.2.)也遵循同样的趋势,从早期的10-12级下降到后期的3-4级,趋同到可与在远景设定中报告的数值相比的数值. 总之,这些结果支持概念发现步骤本身的技术有效性。 我们强调NLMCD方法的稳健性,这种方法从视觉转移到LLMS,而无需调整超参数设置。

blocks.en:
As a sanity check for the soundness of our alignment measure, we exploit the assumption that adjacent layers should show the strongest representational correspondence: for each source layer, we ask whether its best-aligned target layer under a given alignment method, excluding self-alignment, is a direct neighbor. The NN alignment score reports the fraction of layers for which this holds; Neighbor z additionally reports the maximum alignment score (z-standardized across rows) of the direct neighbors to rule out uninformative flat alignment profiles. We compare CBA to CKA with RBF kernel as non-linear baseline and two linear baselines, linear CKA and PCA with 512 dimensions, averaged over 9 model checkpoints (Tab. 1 ; per-model results in App. Tab. 4 ).
All four methods show nearly perfect NN alignment scores, with slight advantages for the non-linear alignment measures CKA(RBF) and CBA, with 0/1 mispredicted neighbors across all layers and models. The Neighbor z score represents the more informative metric in this case and clearly identifies CBA as most informative measure. While the two non-linear methods perform on par in terms of NN Alignment Score, CBA enjoys the additional benefit that it yields concepts as substructures and allows for a more finegrained characterization of the alignment between these substructures.
blocks.zh:
作为对我们的对齐度量是否合理的一种理智检查,我们利用了相邻层应显示最强的表达式对应的假设:对于每个源层,我们询问它在特定对齐方法下最匹配的目标层,不包括自我对齐,是否是一个直接的邻. NN对齐的分数报告它所持有的分数层;NN对齐的分数z另外报告直接邻里的最大对齐分数(z-标准化跨行),排除非信息化的平齐对齐配置. 我们比较CBA和CKA, RBF内核作为非线性基线和两个线性基线,线性CKA和PAC,共512个维度,平均在9个示范检查站(Tab. 1;App. Tab. 4中的每个模型结果)。
所有四种方法都显示了近乎完美的NN对齐分数,对非线性对齐措施CKA(RBF)和CBA有微小的优势,各层和型号的0/1对邻居的预测有误. 邻居z的得分代表了本案中信息更加丰富的衡量标准,并明确了CBA是信息最为丰富的衡量标准. 虽然两种非线性方法在NN对齐分数方面是平等的,但CBA享有额外的好处,即它产生作为子结构的概念,并允许对这些子结构之间的对齐进行更细微的定性。

blocks.en: We also compare the expressiveness of each metric choice in Fig. 3 . When using linear CKA as the alignment metric we can identify two clear block structures but all finer details between layers 6-36 are not visible. In contrast both the PCA-512 and NLMCD methods reveal structures that linear CKA misses. RBF CKA also reduces the near-saturation seen with linear CKA. This stresses that the choice of the alignment metric strongly affects the observable substructures within the model.
blocks.zh: 我们还比较了图3中每个参数选择的表达性。 当使用线性CKA作为对齐度量时,我们可以识别出两个清晰的块状结构,但第6-36层之间所有更细细的细节都不可见. 与之形成对照的是,五氯苯甲醚-512和NLMCD方法都揭示出线性CKA缺失的结构。 RBF CKA还减少了与线性CKA的近饱和度. 这突出表明,调整指标的选择对模型内可观察到的亚结构有重大影响。

blocks.en: Fig. 4 shows the CBA layer-alignment matrices for four models spanning different model families and parameter counts. All matrices exhibit a pronounced diagonal structure, with model-specific variations in the arrangement of aligned layers. For the larger-scale models, except for GPT, the matrices display a band-diagonal structure in the first region, followed by a block structure, a second band-diagonal region, and a final block structure. These patterns are qualitatively similar across the models. All Qwen models share a larger block structure in their middle layers. Compared with the 8B models, the 32B models exhibit a more finegrained structure in the central block. Overall, several larger models exhibit a similar sequence of band-diagonal and block-structured regions, suggesting recurring alignment patterns across model families, see Result 5 for details.
blocks.zh: 图4显示了跨越不同模型家族和参数计数的四个模型的CBA层对齐矩阵. 所有矩阵都表现出明显的对角结构,在排列对齐层时有模型特定的变化. 对于更大的模型,除了GPT,矩阵在第一个区域显示波段对角结构,然后是块结构,第二个波段对角区域,最后是块结构. 这些模式在质量上与模型相似。 所有Quen型号都在其中层拥有更大的区块结构. 与8B型机车相比,32B型机车在中心区块中表现出了更精细的结构. 总体而言,几个较大的模型呈现出类似波段对角和块状结构区域的顺序,表明模型家族之间反复出现的对齐模式,详情见成果5。

blocks.en: We compare properties of annotated concepts aggregated over all residual layers for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B. Those models were chosen as they are comparable in parameter count and number of layers. Concepts were annotated by a labeling LLM along two axes: concept type (syntactic, semantic, mixed, or unclear) and evidence orientation (input, output, both, or unclear). Orientation describes which token and next-token evidence best explains the concept. Semantic and syntactic concept percentages are roughly on-par in Llama (45.7% and 45.1%), while syntactic concepts dominate in Qwen (53.2% versus 39.8% semantic). Regarding the orientation annotation results, input-oriented concepts clearly dominate in both models (93.4% and 96.3% respectively), while concepts with both input and output evidence account for 6.6% and 3.7%. Output-oriented concepts are omitted from the table as neither model has any, see Tab. 5 for details.

blocks.en: Fig. 5 and App. Fig. 10 summarize the layer-dependence of both quantities. The fraction of syntactic concepts stays relatively high across the first two thirds (Qwen)/the first half (Llama) of the model and then shrinks as the fraction of jointly syntactic and semantic concepts starts to rise. This is partly consistent with probing studies on BERT, which found that syntactic information is more locally encoded in earlier layers while semantic tasks benefit from later-layer representations ( Tenney et al., 2019 ) . Our unsupervised concepts show the syntactic-dominance side of this pattern, but show a more nuanced picture, with joint semantic/syntactic concepts becoming more prevalent in later layers. For orientation-annotated concepts the fraction of output-oriented concepts stays close to 0% across all layers. There is, however, a clear increase of concepts annotated as having both input and output evidence towards the later layers in both models.
blocks.zh: 图5和App.图10总结了这两个数量之间的层次依赖。 在模型的前三分之二(Quen)/前半部分(Llama)中,合成概念的分数保持相对较高的水平,然后随着联合合成和语义概念的分数开始上升而缩小. 这与关于BERT的探险研究部分吻合,研究发现,合成信息在较早的层次上比较本地化编码,而语义任务则得益于后层的表达(Tenney等人,2019年). 我们不受监督的概念显示了这种图案的合成-主力侧面,但表现出了更细微的图案,联合语义/合成概念在后几层中越来越普遍. 对于定向附加说明的概念,以产出为导向的概念在所有层次上都保持接近0%的比例。 然而,在两个模型的后几层中,附加说明的有投入和产出证据的概念明显增加。

blocks.en:
In order to quantify the amount of multi-lingual activation taking place within the selected models, we measure joint parallel activation on a parallel corpus of English and Mandarin sentences. To do this, we first conduct concept discovery on a separate joint English-Mandarin text corpus based on English WikiText records and Mandarin Wikipedia sentences. 5,000 sentences are taken in streaming order after filtering from each corpus for concept discovery.
After this a deterministic random 5,000-pair sample of Tatoeba English-Mandarin translations is used as a parallel sentences probe. Concept assignments are computed on the joint clusters for each token in both sentences. Memberships are summed over tokens within each sentence and normalized across concepts to obtain distributions p en p_{\mathrm{en}} and p zh p_{\mathrm{zh}} . Shared mass is ∑ c min ⁡ ( p en , c , p zh , c ) \sum_{c}\min(p_{\mathrm{en},c},p_{\mathrm{zh},c}) , averaged over valid translation pairs.
blocks.zh:
为了量化在选定模式内进行的多种语言激活的数量,我们用英语和普通话句子的并行体衡量联合平行激活。 为此,我们首先根据英语维基文库记录和普通话维基百科句子,在单独的英语-曼达林语联合文本库上进行概念发现. 在从每个实体过滤出来以发现概念后,按流序排列5,000句.
在此之后,Tatoeba英文-Mandarin翻译的确定性随机5000-pair样本被用作平行句子探测器。 概念分配按两句中每个符号的组合计算。 成员在每一句的符号上进行概括,并在概念上实现正常化,以获得p en p_{\mathrm{en}} 和 p zh p_{\mathrm{zh}} 的分布。 共享质量为 ∑ c min ⁡ (p en, c, p zh, c)\ sum _{ c}\ min (p_{\ mathrm{en}, c}, p_{\ mathrm{zh}, c}),平均为有效翻译对.

blocks.en: Tab. 2 shows the results of the multilingual activation experiment. Paired mass is the raw shared mass computed from the parallel sentences probe. However, especially in the larger models we observed layer-specific peaks that did not seem to correlate with multilingual activation, see App. Fig. 11 . We therefore computed a baseline using 200 permutations of the Mandarin sentences per layer, recomputing shared mass and averaging over permutations (shuffled mass). Mean excess is paired mass minus shuffled mass, averaged equally over residual layers. Paired mass and shuffled mass in the table are also layer averages.
blocks.zh: 标签2显示多语种激活实验的结果. Paired质量是从平行句子探测器中计算的原始共享质量. 然而,特别是在更大的模型中,我们观察到的与多语种激活无关的层状峰,见App. 图11。 因此,我们用每层200个普通话句子的表率计算基线,重算共用质量和平均表率(震荡质量)。 平均超量是配对质量减去洗涤质量,平均高于残余层。 表中的保质素和洗涤质素也是层平均值.

blocks.en: In line with our expectation the excess shared mass is close to zero for GPT-2, our predominantly English-trained comparison model and increases for the multilingual Llama and Qwen models. The mean excess increases from 0.0242 to 0.0487 from Llama to Qwen3-4B. After that there is a slight drop of mean excess for Qwen3-8B (0.0430) and Qwen3-32B (0.0392). The peak occurs at layer 7 for Qwen3-4B, layer 8 for Qwen3-8B, and layer 10 for Qwen3-32B. The finding that multilingual concept sharing between typologically distant languages is highly training-dependent rather than a universal property provides an empirical counterpoint to the Platonic Representation Hypothesis ( Huh et al., 2024 ) , in line with prior work on linear SAE representations ( Brinkmann et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 根据我们的预期,GPT-2的超量共享质量接近于零,我们以英语为主的比较模型和多语种的Llama和Quen模型都有所增加。 平均超额从0.0242增加到0.0487,从Llama增加到Qune3-4B。 在此之后,Qune3-8B(0.0430)和Qune3-32B(0.0392)的平均超额略有下降. 峰值在7层为Quen3-4B,8层为Quen3-8B,10层为Quen3-32B. 研究结论认为,语言类型上遥远的语言之间多语种概念共享高度依赖培训,而不是一个普遍属性,这与先前关于线性SAE表述(Brinkmann等人,2025年)的工作一致,为Platonic代表假说(Huh等人,2024年)提供了经验反点。

blocks.en:
In addition to reporting the mean excess for shared mass across layers we also annotated multilingual concepts using a labeling LLM, labeling them as either semantic, syntactic or mixed. At each layer, a concept is selected as translation-shared if active in both sentences of at least 2% of valid translation pairs and at least five pairs. These are 100 pairs with our 5,000 valid pairs. Each sentence independently satisfies the active criterion through top-10 membership or a normalized concept score ≥ 0.03 \geq 0.03 . The labeler uses bilingual training tokens and representative parallel examples. Semantic denotes shared meaning, syntactic includes grammar and surface form, mixed requires both, and unclear denotes insufficient evidence.
Fig. 6 shows the results of the multilingual concept annotation. All three models show an early-layer peak in semantic shared-mass excess that gradually decreases towards the middle layers. Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B also show a local syntactic peak within their first four layers. Among labeled translation-shared concepts, semantic excess is prominent in early layers. Much of the total excess is unlabeled, so this does not establish semantic dominance across all concepts. Shared punctuation and sentence structure are possible explanations for syntactic contributions.
blocks.zh:
除了报告各层共享质量的平均超额外,我们还使用标记LLM的多语种概念,将其标注为语义、综合或混合。 在每层中,如果在两句中活动至少为有效翻译对的2%和至少5对,则选择一个概念作为翻译共享. 这些是100对 和我们的5000对有效对。 每个句子通过前10名成员或正常的概念得分 0.03\ e 0.03 独立满足活动标准. 标签者使用双语培训标志和代表性平行实例。 语义表示共有的意义,综合包括语法和表层形式,两者兼有,而不明确则表示证据不足.
图6显示了多语种概念注释的结果。 所有三种模型都显示出语义共享质量过剩的早期层峰,逐渐向中层下降. Qune3-8B和Qune3-32B也在其前四层内显示局部的合成峰. 在被标注的翻译共享概念中,语义超常在早期层中突出. 全部多余的部分大多没有贴上标签,因此这并不确立所有概念的语义主导地位。 共享的标注和句子结构是综合贡献的可能解释.

blocks.en:
Fig. 7 shows CBA matrices for comparisons between Qwen and Llama model variants. Because Qwen and Llama use different tokenizers, we align their tokens using character spans within the same sentence. We retain a target token only when sampled source-token spans lie wholly within and together cover its complete span. The source tokens’ concept memberships are then mean-pooled before comparison. All R5 CBA comparisons use 1,024 aligned observations per model. Both within-family Qwen comparisons exhibit pronounced depth-structured alignment. High CBA scores form a broad diagonal band, indicating that layers at comparable relative depths encode similar concepts. The alignment comprises an early band, a broad middle block, and a smaller high-alignment region near the output layers; the main difference between Qwen 8B and 32B is an extended middle block. This pattern persists despite differences in scale and layer count, suggesting that Qwen variants preserve a common progression of internal representations.
In contrast, Llama 8B Instruct versus Qwen 8B yields substantially lower CBA scores, although a weak diagonal and middle-layer block structure remain. This indicates limited, locally structured cross-family concept alignment, consistent with prior work reporting weak overall cross-family but strong within-family alignment ( Piepereit, 2026 ) . Nevertheless, the result shows that the internal organization does not look similar, see Result 2, but rather supports the hypothesis of corresponding functional blocks even across different model families.
blocks.zh:
图7显示了CBA矩阵,用于对Quen和Llama模型变体进行比较. 因为Quen和Llama使用不同的标语器,我们用同一句内的字符跨度来调整他们的符号. 我们只保留一个目标标志 当采样的源头跨度 完全在并且一起覆盖整个跨度。 源代码的概念成员数目在进行比较之前就被平均汇总。 所有R5 CBA比较使用每个模型1,024对齐的观测. 家庭内部的Quen比较显示出明显的深度结构一致。 高CBA分数形成宽对角波段,表明可比相对深度的层层编码类似的概念. 配位包括一个早期的波段,宽的中间块,以及靠近输出层的较小的高配位区; Qwen 8B和32B的主要区别是扩展的中间块. 尽管规模和层数不同,但这种模式依然存在,表明Quen的变式保持了内部表述的共同进展。
相比之下,Llama 8B Instruct对Quen 8B的得分则大幅降低CBA的得分,不过仍然存在着弱的对角和中层区块结构. 这表明地方结构的跨家庭概念的调整有限,与以往工作报告相比,整体跨家庭的调整薄弱,但家庭内部的调整也很有力(Piepereit,2026年)。 尽管如此,结果显示内部组织看起来并不相似,参见"结果2",而是支持甚至跨不同模型家族的相应功能块的假设.

blocks.en: Figure 7: CBA Similarity Scores between models. Left: Qwen 4b vs 8b, Center: Qwen 8b vs. 32b, Right: Llama 8b instruct vs. Qwen 8b
blocks.zh: 图7:CBA的相似性 模型间得分. 左:文4b对8b,中:文8b对32b,右:Llama 8b指示对文8b

blocks.en: We compare the three finetuned Tulu-3-8B variants with their base model, Llama-3.1-8B. Fig. 8 reports CBA scores for corresponding layers across model pairs. Alignment between adjacent training stages is high, consistent with the claim that objective consistency supports consistent representational similarity patterns ( Ciernik et al., 2025 ) . DPO and the final RLVR model are particularly closely aligned, with scores remaining near 0.85 0.85 – 0.86 0.86 across most layers, suggesting that RLVR largely preserves the concept geometry established during DPO rather than reorganizing intermediate representations. Comparisons involving the SFT model show lower, intermediate alignment, indicating a larger representational change during supervised finetuning. This is consistent with parameter-level evidence on the same checkpoints: SFT induces dense updates, including from Llama-3.1-8B to Tulu-3-8B-SFT, whereas DPO leaves about 81% of the SFT model’s parameters unchanged ( Mukherjee et al., 2025 ) . Across all stages, alignment remains above 0.8 0.8 , higher than typical cross-model alignment scores, suggesting that most concepts are formed during pretraining and are only moderately modified by subsequent finetuning.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了三个微调的图鲁-3-8B变体与它们的基模型Llama-3.1-8B. 图8报告CBA分数对应层跨模型对. 相邻培训阶段之间的一致程度很高,这与下述说法是一致的,即客观一致性支持一贯的代表性相似性模式(Ciernik等人,2025年)。 DPO和最终的RLVR模型特别紧密的对齐,分数在大多数层次上仍然保持接近0.85 0.85 – 0.86 0.86,这表明RLVR在很大程度上保留了DPO期间建立的概念几何,而不是重组中间代表. 涉及SFT模型的比较显示中低度对齐,表明在有监督的微调过程中代表的变化较大. 这与同一检查站的参数级证据是一致的:SFT诱导密集更新,包括从Llama-3.1-8B到Tulu-3-8B-SFT,而DPO则留下约81%的SFT模型参数不变(Mukherjee等人,2025年)。 在所有阶段,对齐仍然高于0.8 0.8,高于典型的跨型对齐分数,这表明大多数概念都是在预训期间形成的,只是通过后续的微调进行中度修改.

blocks.en:
Most model pairs show an alignment drop from layer 14 to layer 15, which is substantially larger in comparisons involving the base model. The effect is not confined to layer 15: alignment remains reduced until approximately layer 22, after which it gradually recovers and, for DPO–RLVR, eventually exceeds its layer-14 value. Alignment also drops sharply at the final layer in every comparison, consistent with increased specialization toward next-token prediction. The same pattern is visible in the alignment matrices in App. Fig. 12 . Overall, alignment changes are larger relative to the base model than between successive finetuning stages, with DPO and the final RLVR checkpoint remaining most closely aligned.
The fact that across all finetuning stages the drop occurs after layer 14 indicates that this layer is of particular importance for the behavior of the model that is supposedly adapted during post-training.
blocks.zh:
大多数模型对子显示从第14层到第15层的对齐下降,这在涉及基模型的比较中大得多. 该效应不局限于第15层:对齐度持续降低至约第22层,之后逐渐恢复,对DPO-RLVR而言,最终超过其第14层值. 在每次比较中,对齐在最后一层也急剧下降,这与更专业化地进行下层预测是一致的。 在App.Fig. 12中的对齐矩阵中也可以看到同样的模式. 总体而言,相对于基准模型,对齐的变化大于连续的微调阶段,DPO和最终的RLVR检查站保持最紧密的对齐.
在所有微调阶段中,下降发生在第14层之后,这一事实表明,这一层对于在训练后被调整的模型的行为特别重要。

blocks.en: To investigate the alignment drop between layers 14 and 15, we apply partial concept matching based on the Hungarian algorithm. We augment the concept-cost matrix with dummy assignments whose cost equals the match-acceptance threshold, set to 0.0025 0.0025 in all experiments. This allows concepts to remain unmatched when all real assignments exceed that cost, rather than forcing high-cost one-to-one matches. Fig. 13 overlays the resulting matches on the pairwise cost matrices for SFT and DPO, where layer-15 shows a weaker and less coherent diagonal structure than layer 14.
blocks.zh: 为了调查第14层和第15层之间的对齐下降,我们应用基于匈牙利算法的部分概念匹配. 我们用假任务来增加概念成本矩阵,其成本相当于所有实验中的匹配接受阈值,定为0.0025 0.0025。 这使得在所有实际任务超过这一费用时,概念仍然无法匹配,而不是强迫高成本的一对一匹配。 图13在SFT和DPO的对称成本矩阵上覆盖了由此产生的匹配,其中第15层显示的对角结构比第14层更弱、更不一致。

blocks.en: App. Tab. 6 shows representative SFT–DPO concept matches at layers 14 and 15. Layer-14 matches are generally more semantically coherent, with the highest-scoring pairs consisting predominantly of function- or structure-related tokens. In contrast, layer-15 matches are more heterogeneous and often semantically weaker; even highly ranked pairs can mismatch, e.g. “Name beginnings” vs. “Equality symbols”. Layer 15 also yields more unmatched concepts in both directions. Together with the lower CBA alignment, these observations suggest that the layer-14 to 15 transition changes the concepts represented after DPO rather than uniformly reducing similarity.
blocks.zh: App. Tab. 6在14层和15层显示有代表性的SFT-DPO概念匹配. 层-14火柴一般比较一致,得分最高的对子主要由函数或结构相关符组成. 相比之下,第一层-15火柴的种类比较多,而且往往在规模上比较弱;即使排名高的对也有可能不匹配,例如. “名称开头”对“平等符号”。 第15层在两个方向上也产生更多不匹配的概念. 这些意见加上较低的CBA对齐,表明层-14至15个过渡会改变DPO之后代表的概念,而不是统一降低相似性.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Pairwise same-layer CBA alignment across the Llama-3.1-8B base model and the SFT, DPO, and final RLVR checkpoints of Tulu-3.
blocks.zh: 图8:在Llama-3.1-8B基模和SFT,DPO以及Tulu-3的最终RLVR检查站之间对等的同层CBA对齐.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and future work
blocks.zh: 5 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: First, we do not evaluate models above ∼ \sim 32B parameters or mixture-of-experts architectures. This is partly a compute constraint, and partly because our core claims concern the existence and cross-layer structure of non-linear concept manifolds rather than their scaling behavior at frontier scale. However, we acknowledge both directions as very interesting directions for future research. Second, the computational complexity of the approach is dominated by the HDBSCAN clustering step. Given our time and budget constraints this limits the number of tokens to O ⁡ ( 100 ​ k ) O(100k) . Devising a computationally less expensive alternative is therefore a worthwhile direction for future research. Third, the discovered concepts rely on the extraction corpus. Even though Wikipedia text provides a broad basis, some of the semantic concepts in intermediate layers are highly specific and further ones at a similar level of detail might not have been sufficiently activated. Finally, the approach can be used for more in-depth studies of the identified concepts along the lines sketched in Result 6.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们不评估在\\sim 32B参数或专家混合结构之上的模型。 这部分是计算上的制约因素,部分是因为我们的核心主张涉及非线性概念的多面体的存在和跨层结构,而不是其在前沿尺度上的行为。 然而,我们承认这两个方向是今后研究非常有趣的方向。 其次,该方法的计算复杂性以HDBSCAN集群步骤为主. 鉴于我们的时间和预算限制,这限制了O(100k)O(100k)的标志数量。 因此,设计一种计算成本较低的替代品是今后研究的一个值得注意的方向。 第三,发现的概念依赖于提取物。 尽管维基百科文本提供了广泛的基础,但中间层中的一些语义概念非常具体,在类似详细程度的进一步概念可能还没有得到充分的激活. 最后,该方法可用于按照成果6中概述的思路,更深入地研究已确定的概念。

blocks.en: A.1 Model Selection
blocks.zh: A.1 模式选择

blocks.en: We evaluate our approach on nine checkpoints drawn from four model families, chosen to jointly satisfy four criteria: (1) architectural purity — dense, purely text-trained decoders wherever a claim is language-specific, so that representational geometry is not confounded with joint vision-language training; (2) comparability to prior mechanistic-interpretability work , since Result 1 sanity-checks our measure against CKA and PCA baselines reported in the literature; (3) targeted coverage of the specific axis each result section requires (sanity-checking, scale, cross-architecture alignment, multilinguality, training stage); and (4) feasibility under a fixed compute budget , which rules out broad sweeps across many independent families or model sizes above ∼ \sim 30B parameters. Tab. 3 summarizes the resulting suite and which result section each checkpoint supports.
blocks.zh: 我们评价我们从四个模范家庭抽取的9个检查站的做法,这些检查站是为了共同满足4项标准:(1) 建筑纯度——无论何种说法是针对语言的,都是经过严格文字训练的解码器,这样代表几何学不会与联合视觉语言培训相混淆;(2) 与以前的机械解释工作具有可比性,因为结果1对文献中报告的CKA和PCA基线的衡量标准进行了明智度检查;(3) 目标覆盖每个结果部分所要求的具体轴线(检查系统、规模、跨结构调整、多语种性、培训阶段);以及(4) 根据固定计算预算的可行性,该预算将排除许多独立家庭或超过XX\\sim 30B参数的模型规模。 标签3概述了由此产生的套房和每个检查站支助的区段。

blocks.en: Serves as our mechanistic-interpretability anchor. Despite being the oldest model in our suite, it is the model against which the majority of existing SAE- and NMF-based concept-extraction results have been reported, making it essential for situating our manifold-based proximity measure relative to prior linear approaches (Result 1). Its small size and English-only pretraining also make it our contrast case in the multilingual analysis (Result 4).
blocks.zh: 我们的机械解释主播 尽管它是我们套间中最古老的模式,但它是报告大多数现有基于SAE和NMF的概念提取结果所依据的模式,因此,相对于先前的线性方法,确定我们基于多重的近距离测量方法的位置至关重要(结果1)。 其规模小,仅限英语预训,这也使我们在多语种分析(Result 4)中形成对比.

blocks.en: Provides our primary cross-architecture reference point at the ∼ \sim 8B scale (Results 2, 3, 5), and supplies the base weights underlying our finetuning-stage case study (see below). We retain this mid-2024 checkpoint rather than substituting a newer Llama release because Llama 4 (April 2025) moved to a mixture-of-experts, natively multimodal early-fusion architecture, which no longer satisfies our architectural-purity criterion; Llama-3.1-8B is thus the most recent Llama checkpoint compatible with our design.
blocks.zh: 提供\\sim 8B比例尺(结果2、3、5)上的主要跨结构参考点,并提供我们微调阶段案例研究的基础权重(见下文)。 由于Llama 4(2025年4月)转而使用本地多式早期融合建筑,不再符合我们的建筑纯度标准,我们保留了这个2024年中检查站,而不是取代新的Llama释放;Llama 3.1-8B因此是符合我们设计的最新Llama检查站。

blocks.en: Supply our within-family scale sweep (Result 2) and our multilingual analysis (Result 4), holding architecture and training recipe fixed while varying parameter count roughly eightfold. Qwen3-8B additionally forms our matched-scale cross-architecture pair with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (Results 2–4), chosen as the comparison point because Qwen3 and Llama-3.1 differ substantially in data provenance, tokenizer, and multilingual coverage. We use the dense Qwen3 line rather than the more recent Qwen3.5/3.6 releases because, from Qwen3.5 onward, Alibaba’s flagship checkpoints are trained natively multimodally via early fusion of vision and text tokens; using these would confound our scale and multilingual claims with differences in training paradigm rather than isolating parameter count and language as intended. Qwen3 dense models remain purely text-trained, cover 119 languages including Mandarin, and are, to our knowledge, the most recent checkpoints from any major open-weight family that satisfy our text-only constraint at time of writing — a recency/architectural-purity tradeoff we make explicit rather than an unexamined limitation.
blocks.zh: 提供我们的家庭内部规模扫描(结果2)和我们的多语种分析(结果4),将建筑和培训配方固定下来,而不同的参数大约为8倍。 Qune3-8B 与 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (Results 2–4) 形成相匹配的跨结构结构配对, 我们使用密集的Quen3线,而不是最近的Qwen3.5/3.6线,因为从Quen3.5到现在,阿里巴巴的旗舰检查站都通过早期的视觉和文字符号组合,在本土进行多模式培训;使用这些符号会把我们的规模和多语种说法与培训模式的不同混淆起来,而不是按原意孤立参数数和语言。 203稠密模式仍然是纯文字训练的,涵盖119种语言,包括普通话,据我们所知,是任何主要的开放重量家庭的最新检查站,在撰写本报告时满足了我们仅限文字的限制——这是我们明确而非未经审查的重任/建筑纯洁权衡。

blocks.en: Supports our finetuning-drift case study (Result 6). Unlike most publicly released instruction-tuned models, which expose only base and final checkpoints, the Tulu 3 pipeline — built on Llama-3.1-8B base weights — publishes each intermediate training stage explicitly. This lets us attribute representational drift separately to supervised finetuning and to preference/RL-based optimization (DPO, then RLVR), rather than collapsing both into a single base-to-instruct delta, which a single additional checkpoint could not support. We chose this suite over comparable alternatives (e.g., OLMo 2) because it shares its base initialization with the Llama-3.1-8B checkpoint used elsewhere in our suite, allowing a direct comparison between Meta’s RLHF-tuned Instruct release and AI2’s independently-tuned Tulu 3 endpoint as a secondary check on how sensitive our drift measure is to the specific finetuning pipeline, not only its stages. blocks.en: A.3 Concept annotation

blocks.en: We use Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501 to label each cluster from its up to 20 most frequent decoded tokens, four causal sentence contexts, and ten most frequent next-token predictions derived from the extraction corpus. Greedy decoding produces a 2–6-word English label. A separate prompt classifies the English concepts in Result 3 by type (semantic, syntactic, mixed, or unclear) and evidence orientation (input, output, both, or unclear). A third prompt classifies translation-shared concepts in Result 4. All three tasks use a single user message formatted with the labeler’s chat template and greedy decoding ( do_sample=False ). The generation limits are 30 tokens for concept names and 100 tokens for each classification task. Prompts, evidence, raw generations, and cleaned labels are retained. Labels are hypotheses for inspection that do not enter UMAP, HDBSCAN, CBA, or any other discovery metric. The R3 and R4 category summaries do depend on these annotations ( Bills et al., 2023 ) .

blocks.en: This prompt supplies the descriptive labels used for concept inspection and matching examples. These names are not supplied to the R3 or R4 classifiers. You are analysing the internal representations of a language model (<model identifier>, <number of layers> transformer layers total). You are looking at <layer description>. The tokens below come from <corpus description> text, split into subwords by its tokenizer (<tokenizer revision>). The following subword tokens cluster together in the model’s activation space at this layer — meaning they trigger a similar internal representation pattern. Input tokens: <top input tokens> Predicted next tokens (what the full model predicts will follow these input tokens): <top predicted next tokens> <depth-dependent note> Example sentences: - ’<token>’ in: <causal sentence prefix> <up to four examples> Task: Give a short label (2–6 words) naming what these tokens have in common. Guidelines: •For morphological fragments (prefixes, suffixes, stems), describe their grammatical function rather than calling them ’fragments’ or ’subwords’ (e.g. ’verb suffix -ing’, ’plural noun endings -s/-es’, ’past tense -ed’). •Avoid vague catch-alls such as ’abbreviations’, ’subwords’, ’legal terms’, ’fragments’, or ’German text’ unless all tokens genuinely share that specific property. •Prefer a specific, distinctive label over a generic one. •Output ONLY the label — no explanation, no punctuation at the end, no quotes. The layer description identifies the residual block and its relative depth. The next-token note varies with rounded relative depth, as follows; this is part of the labeling prompt, not a measured property of the layer. Early (below 40%). Note: at this early depth the predicted next tokens reflect the full model but may not align closely with the current representations — use them as a secondary signal. Intermediate (40–69%). Note: at this intermediate depth the predicted next tokens are moderately informative about the layer’s function. Late (at least 70%). Note: at this late depth the predicted next tokens are closely connected to the layer’s representations — weight them heavily when labelling. For boundary-only or empty decoded tokens, the prompt additionally states: The visible token is only a standalone boundary/whitespace marker or otherwise decodes to an empty string. Use the causal sentence prefixes and predicted next tokens below to characterise the contextual representation captured by this cluster. Do not label it merely as an unknown concept. When begin-of-sequence markers dominate the displayed tokens, an additional guideline states: Most tokens here are ’<s>’ (begin-of-sequence marker). Use the example sentences and predicted next tokens to characterise what type of content or article this cluster captures (e.g. ’Biographical article opening’, ’Technical Wikipedia intro’, ’Sentence-initial Die/The’).

blocks.en: The input contains up to 20 input tokens, ten predicted next tokens, and four contexts. Each context string is truncated to its first 200 characters by the classifier. Top tokens in cluster: <top input tokens> Predicted next tokens: <top predicted next tokens> Example sentences (cut at the token position): - ’<token>’ in: <causal sentence prefix> <up to four examples> Classify two independent properties. concept_type must be one of semantic, syntactic, mixed, unclear. Use mixed when both are material. orientation must be one of input, output, both, unclear. Input means the current token and causal context best explain the cluster. Output means the predicted next-token evidence best explains it. Use both only when both evidence sources independently support the interpretation. The predicted tokens come from the final language-model head and are auxiliary evidence, not a direct readout from this intermediate layer. blocks.en: This prompt is applied to concepts selected as translation-shared by the activation-frequency criterion in Result 4, independently of statistical significance. It uses up to 12 training tokens per language with counts and four representative parallel examples. Each sentence is truncated to 320 characters; these bilingual examples are sentence-level evidence, rather than the causal prefixes used above. Layer identity and shared-pair counts and rates are withheld. This task returns a type, a short English description, and a reason. Judge the activation evidence, not merely whether the two sentences are translations. blocks.zh: 表6:匈牙利代表对SFT和DPO在14层和15层的比对. 费用较低表明其相似性更大。 “不相称的”概念被分配给私人假节点。 在所有实验中,为假节点分配火柴的门槛定为0.0025。
